read.thesis: Q1 CY26 revenue up 11% (10% FX-adj) and EPS up 18% to $4.28 on 9% FX-adj spend growth, the fastest in three years; FY26 guidance reaffirmed, with marketing and tech spend raised.

triggers.label: Card Member spend growth 9% FX-adj
triggers.quote: Card Member spending grew 9 percent FX-adjusted, the highest quarterly growth in three years

triggers.label: FY26 guidance reaffirmed, EPS $17.30-17.90
triggers.quote: we're reaffirming our full-year 2026 guidance for 9 to 10 percent revenue growth and EPS of $17.30 to $17.90

triggers.label: Net write-off rate 2.0% vs 2.1%
triggers.quote: The first-quarter net write-off rate was 2.0 percent, compared to 2.1 percent a year ago.

guidance.quote: reaffirming our full-year 2026 guidance for 9 to 10 percent revenue growth

red_flags.label: Provisions up on lower reserve release
red_flags.quote: The increase reflected higher net write-offs and a lower reserve release compared to the prior year.

red_flags.label: Opex growth from marketing and tech investment
red_flags.quote: decided to increase our investments in marketing and technology to capitalize on long-term growth opportunities
